title: Who played in Jelly Roll's California band
summary: Vernon Melton on trumpet, Willie Woodman on trombone, and Ernest Johnson in the Black and Tan band.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Who was in Jelly Roll's band? I'm... Bill Russell's real interested in Jelly Roll, so I thought I'd ask you about it. But Russell wants to know all he can about Jelly Roll.
Well, I tell you, Jelly Roll had a band. Yeah, the fellow named... Was playing trumpet by the name of Melton.
Vernon Melton. Never heard of him.
No, because he wasn't. He wasn't... In this... Really in the bracket of... Playing jazz, you know.
Or nothing. But Jelly used to just scrap up different players, you know. Oh. Pick up different man, the best he could, you see. I had a father named Willie Woodman who was playing trombone with him.
When it was like that, I used to... Go out and... They lived right near the Yump Stadium.

I used to go out there and play with them kids here. Yeah. There was three of them. In fact, four of them. That fourth one, they couldn't do nothing with him. They tried to make a drummer out of him. They didn't want that. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. and then going out in California. We was working together. I played with him with the Black and Tanned Band in California. Ernest. You know all I know Ernest Johnson and when I come and found him here in California it was Kaiko. I don't know what a Kaiko.

Well that was Philip Kaiko was his brother. Cripple Pill. You remember Cripple Pill? I think he played banjo. No clarinet play. Yeah that was his brother and he was Kaiko. Yeah? Yeah. But I don't know and that's what Billy Moran's son, Lawrence Marrero used to call him Kaiko. Yeah. Did he ever play with Jelly Roll? Would you know? Who? Ernest Johnson. You wouldn't know maybe. Ernest was playing with the Black and Tanned. I don't think so now. Oh yeah. And what about Jelly Roll's band that he put up you know after he came back to California just before he died?
